summary: Residential kerb where cars park, but houses sit 10-14 m away.

best_section.where: Goldsbrough Road north kerb, mid-block between the corner and the left bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12-14 m behind the north kerb along the whole stretch; houses opposite too.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked kerbside on both sides; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; a shop cluster at the corner end.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

sun_shade: Mostly open; patchy tree shade from the north side near 30-40 m.
